body:
I took 15mg of edible THC in gummy form
Felt good within 45 minutes, after a few hours felt tired went to sleep. Woke up from a vivid dream 2 hours later, felt like I was experiencing auditory hallucinations and was feeling uneasy. Started to see patterns of faces on the rug some cartoonish some realistic. I had intensity to urinate and was peeing out straight clear urine. I kept drinking water but not for cottonmouth just felt like I had to drink water despite being well hydrated before taking edibles. I started hearing people laughing at me but nobody was awake it was real early morning... Felt like an intense acid trip without colorful visuals. Subtle visual distortions and auditory hallucinations.
I decided to move around and clean up to ease my panic attack. After awhile I ended up feeling drained then I took a 2 hour nap feeling better.
